Class CarDealership

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.first.spring.model.BaseEntity
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.first.spring.model.CarDealership
@Entity public class CarDealership extends BaseEntity
Represents a car dealership entity. This class serves as the root XML element for JAXB transformation.
